source_metadata.method: Terminal data — 12-month blended-forward consensus P/E, weekly
source_metadata.perTicker: constituent trailing-twelve-month EPS, one snapshot per name
source_metadata.forwardOwnMethod: Blended forward 12M: FY1/FY2 consensus net income weighted by published ETF holdings; one point per day. Agrees with the terminal blended-forward series to within 3% on all four universes (verified 2026-08-05).

forward.note: Trailing PE is cap-weighted Σ(w·P)/Σ(w·trailingEps) computed from the 100 NDX constituents daily; with no comparable long-run series for NDX no historical seed is shown yet, and the line will fill in over time as we update regularly. Forward PE is terminal data — 12-month blended-forward consensus estimates back to April 2001, published as one point per week (the last reading of each week). Alongside it we publish a second forward series computed daily from consensus estimates and published ETF holdings, never blended into the first.
forward.non_comparability: terminal_weekly and own_daily are separate methods; must not treat as one continuous historical series
